what: The starts test (sessions/006/engineering/plan_1.md, Section 2.3): C1 to C8 from starts 9 to 13, each searched for 320 steps and scored on its own batch only, and C1 from start 1 as the guard. Harms in nats; a search's record holds its harm at the start and after each of its 320 steps; the own harms are its own-batch re-scores, per text, at the start and at each saved setting.
